title: Springtime in the Hills (Ka Pyrem)
cultural_context: Lyrical celebration of spring (Ka Pyrem) when cherry blossoms, rhododendrons, and wild violets carpet the Khasi highlands.
lyrics_khasi:
Ka pyrem ka la wan
Ha ki lum jong ka Ri,
Ki khlaw ki la phong
Jain kup ba jyrngam;
Ki syntiew ki pait
Ha man ki sawdong them,
U tiew diengngai u phuh
Ha syndah ki wahduid.

Ki ksuid tlang ki la phet,
Ka khriat ka la jah noh,
Ka jingim thymmai
Ha dohnud ka kynud;
Rwai lang, ko khun ka Ri,
Ia ka Meiramew ba bha,
Ba ai biang ka sngi
Bad ka jingshai ka pyrem.
lyrics_english:
Springtime has arrived
Across our hills of the Motherland,
The forests have donned
Their robes of emerald green;
Wild flowers burst open
In every fold of the valley,
The rhododendron blooms
Beside the flowing rills.

The winter chills have fled,
The biting frost is gone,
Fresh renewed vitality
Humming within the breast;
Sing together, children of the soil,
Praising kind Mother Earth,
Who bestows once more the sunlight
And the golden glow of spring.

khasi: Ha ki lum jong ka Ri,
english: Across our hills of the Motherland,
In every fold of the valley,

khasi: Ki ksuid tlang ki la phet,
Ka khriat ka la jah noh,
Rwai lang, ko khun ka Ri,
english: Sing together, children of the soil,
Who bestows once more the sunlight
And the golden glow of spring.
